payload.title: comment thread loads existing comments
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toHaveCount(4)

Locator: getByTestId('comment-item')
Expected: 4
Received: 0

note: An empty comment thread reads like a broken empty state or an off-by-one query, but failedRequests shows the comments API request failing at the connection level (status 0, no HTTP response at all) rather than returning an empty list — the service was unreachable, not the UI mishandling a valid empty response.
